headword: {固定資産税|こていしさんぜい}

definitions.explanation: A municipal tax charged every year on the owners of land, buildings, and business equipment, based on the assessed value as of January 1. Home owners pay it in installments after a tax notice arrives in spring.

examples.japanese: {固定資産税|こていしさんぜい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{固定資産税|こていしさんぜい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: When you buy a house, you have to pay property tax.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{五月|ごがつ}→五月：00625_gogatsu⟧ごろ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{固定資産税|こていしさんぜい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{納税通知書|のうぜいつうちしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: The property tax notice arrives around May every year.

notes:
Literally ⟦{固定|こてい}→固定：10996_kotei⟧ (fixed) + ⟦{資産|しさん}→資産：15655_shisan⟧ (assets) + ⟦{税|ぜい}→税：03767_zei⟧ (tax). Paid to the city, town, or village where the property is, not to the national government.

- {固定資産税|こていしさんぜい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{納|おさ}める→納める：02280_osameru⟧: to pay property tax
- {固定資産税|こていしさんぜい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: property tax is charged
- {固定資産税|こていしさんぜい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{評価額|ひょうかがく}: the assessed value for property tax
